title: ai-rulez exposure collisions
description: Output of `ai-rulez exposure collisions --format json`: pairs of skills and agents listed at session start, of different areas, ranked by the Jaccard index of the words of their listings. See docs/exposure.md.

root.description: The absolute repository root, slash separated.

plugins.description: The plugin mode of the inventory.

artifacts_compared.description: The number of skills and agents listed at session start.

total.description: The number of pairs at or over min_score, before --limit.

collisions.description: The pairs, highest score first, then by first and second path; at most --limit of them.

score.description: Shared words over the words of either listing.

shared.description: The words both listings use, sorted.

first.description: The path of the artifact that comes first in the inventory.
